name: Biomedical Sciences PhD Program
detailsNote: The admissions page says applications completed by December 1 of the previous year get full consideration, with no calendar year, so it is shown as a published date. How students are admitted (program or lab) is not stated on the pages read.
summary: PhD in Biomedical Sciences at the Florida State University College of Medicine. Admitted students are appointed as graduate research assistants.

publishedDeadlines.label: Full-consideration deadline (year not stated)
publishedDeadlines.note: The admissions page says applications completed by December 1 of the previous year receive full consideration and are considered for a limited number of University Fellowships. Admission is for the fall term only. Confirm the date for Fall 2027.

english.note: International applicants whose native language is not English must submit official English proficiency results by the application deadline, unless they qualify for a university waiver (for example a US bachelor's degree). No minimum scores are listed on the page read.

applicationFee.note: The page says the Office of Graduate Admissions does not waive the application fee for graduate applicants.

documents: Statement of purpose naming at least three faculty members
GRE scores or an approved GRE waiver
requirements.note: Official scores from the GRE or an equivalent such as the MCAT are required unless an approved waiver applies. Applicants who meet GPA and research background criteria may request a GRE waiver, which does not guarantee admission.

funding.note: Admitted students are appointed as graduate research assistants with a stipend above the minimum set by the union contract, tuition waivers and a health insurance subsidy. No stipend amount is given. Support is contingent on satisfactory performance.
